scope: Bounded executable witness inventory for K1 selection, K2 reusable data, K3 ordered core, selected M1a recipes, quantities, readable SV/LG and the dated Quest method. Requirement IDs refer to conformance-ledger.md; K1-K3 milestone meanings come from release-scope-ld02.md. This inventory maps inspected assertions and does not itself record a passing execution.
limitations: A witnessed row covers its described variation, not every variant of its linked requirements or all combinations. The conformance ledger remains the broader domain inventory.
Stage labels identify paths exercised by the selected method under its default configuration. A run must record effective backends and disabling environment variables before crediting those paths.
parser/checker labels include admission on the described successful path; they do not establish exhaustive grammar, type-rule or diagnostic coverage.
audit denotes native IR interpreter trace assertions. Emitted Lean values/state/errors are compared, but emitted target decision coverage is not measured.
Input paths include source templates and neutral fixture builders where a test creates source or bindings in memory; exact generated bytes must be retained by a validation campaign.
Reference evaluators are differential checks; only the named neutral-fact oracles provide independent financial controls. Shared runtime helpers limit backend independence.
Financial policies are bounded synthetic or adopted development choices. No vendor parity, professional approval, production payment execution or whole-compiler correctness is established.

features.description: Greatest matching integer priority, explicit fallback, winning zero, tied-top rejection and lazy bodies.

witnesses.property: Ten source variants compare values, closing state and diagnostics across four paths; native selection candidates and topological references are inspected, including zero and predicate failure.
witnesses.oracle: Hand-selected expected amounts and error codes in the source witness table; no neutral-fact financial oracle.

limitations: Direct generated sources do not alone establish canonical rule delivery or exhaustive scope/date near misses.

features.description: Registered Cedar selection with two participant outputs and explicit scope/effective-date rejection.

witnesses.property: Default compare run yields two earned amounts of 20 and confirms reference agreement.
Tied top rule, unknown territory, effective-end equality and unauthorized participant block with no statements or closing state.
witnesses.oracle: Explicit expected diagnostic codes for each package mutation.

limitations: The negative canonical selector uses the reference backend; it must not be credited with native negative execution.

features.description: Options, structural rows, tuple map keys, duplicate rejection, grouping and occurrence-preserving joins.

witnesses.property: Twelve source/binding variants compare emitted values/state/errors to reference, including absent versus present zero, 2x3 inner-join multiplicity, empty relations and eager key failures; native dependencies are topological.
witnesses.oracle: Explicit diagnostic table plus reference differential comparison; separate test_reference_witnesses contains the hand-expected grouped rows.

limitations: No generic relational cardinality theorem or complete canonical transport proof; source-level named schema registries remain outside the claimed structural-record variation.

features.description: Finite fold, identified ordered fold, deterministic ties and strict linked function calls.

witnesses.property: Eleven generated variants check ordered values, empty initial state, stopping failure, duplicate identity, unresolved event order, strict arguments, isolated names and transitive imports; native failed steps and DAG ordering are asserted.
witnesses.oracle: Hand-selected outputs 123, 9, 12, 8 and 7 plus specified failure codes; reference differential comparison.

limitations: An immutable fold accumulator is not a published financial state cell or authority to select new event economics.

features.description: Generic structured state transport with actual published successor lineage.

witnesses.property: Nested structured state is published and reused by a successor invocation; exact nested money, transition movement and result lineage are asserted.
witnesses.oracle: Explicit nested balance and lineage assertions in the generic module fixture.

limitations: This selector uses the reference backend. It is a transport/lineage witness, not native event-economics coverage.

features.description: Seven registered ordinary-royalty recipes with independent neutral-fact intermediates.

witnesses.property: Expected entitlements 20/30/12/30/30/100/15, basis, uncapped amounts and closing meters match the neutral oracle; linked IR and emitted artifacts exist in default compare mode.
witnesses.oracle: oracles/ordinary_royalties.py consumes neutral facts; additional hand entitlement/balance controls are embedded in the test.

limitations: SPL_M1_BACKEND overrides default compare execution and must be recorded or rejected by the runner. This is seven recipes, not all C04/C05 variants or every composition.

features.description: Threshold equality and actual adjacent-period cumulative basis carry.

witnesses.property: Basis exactly 100 gives marginal entitlement 10 and whole-base entitlement 20.
witnesses.oracle: Independent ordinary_royalties plus explicit threshold controls.

witnesses.property: Published closing state is read from JSON, bound as successor opening and yields entitlement 10 with cumulative basis 200 and result lineage.
witnesses.oracle: Independent ordinary_royalties, including original neutral scope/period/opening facts.

limitations: Default compare stages depend on SPL_M1_BACKEND. Adjacent successor carry does not establish arbitrary gaps or general dependent-period replay.

features.description: Exact typed Quantity and Rate arithmetic for Download and UsageMinute.

witnesses.property: Both quantity/rate unit families compare arithmetic, exact cancellation, matching quantization and typed empty sums across four paths with topological native traces.
witnesses.oracle: Explicit expected tagged results in the test plus reference differential comparison.

limitations: SPL_QUANTITIES_REFERENCE_ONLY=1 omits native and emitter paths without unittest skips. The finite unit dictionary does not cover arbitrary units or FX.

features.description: Canonical tagged Download facts, independent controls and actual native successor meter carry.

witnesses.property: 100, zero and one-third Download compare gross, earned, period quantity and closing quantity to neutral controls; the actual 100-unit closing cell feeds the native successor 100.5/0.375 witness.
witnesses.oracle: oracles/quantities.py consumes neutral facts independently of canonical projection.

limitations: This scoped synthetic method selects nonnegative activity and USD. It does not complete signed return policies or broader unit conversions.

features.description: Accepted controlled readable SV, LG and RQ-07 schedules execute through the canonical boundary.

witnesses.property: Canonical outputs retain payable 18000/35/18000 and readable-source metadata; native trace nodes have unique IDs, exact type/outcome fields and topologically valid dependencies/references.
witnesses.oracle: Historical hand payable controls and reference/native/emitted comparison; this selector does not use a dedicated neutral-fact SV/LG oracle.

limitations: Finite deterministic readable expansion is not general natural-language interpretation. These remain legacy canonical profiles, not migration to generic modules.

features.description: Dated Quest two-flow method uses original dates, exact certificates and half-even rounding of the additional charge.

witnesses.property: Baseline 95.17, principal-cent half-even tie 0 and non-origin two-day charge 1 match independent neutral controls, exact minimum/predecessor/cell certificates, explicit payment statuses and no state.
witnesses.oracle: oracles/quest.py nominates with Decimal and certifies with exact Fraction powers from original facts; it does not reuse SPL search.

limitations: Exactly one obligation, one full principal payment and one application; pinned calendar dates and bounded days/search domain. Monthly/combined liability and additional payment remain uncomputed or unresolved.

features.description: Two deliberately wrong rounding interpretations fail exact certificates.

witnesses.property: Source mutations to half-away and round-terminal-total calculations are blocked by the unchanged exact rounding-cell requirements on the discriminating principal-cent tie.
witnesses.oracle: Exact certificate assertions and named expected blocking codes; selected mutation witnesses, not a mutation adequacy percentage.

limitations: QUEST_REFERENCE_ONLY=1 omits native paths without unittest skips. Two chosen mutations are not a systematic mutation campaign.

features.description: Linked signed reversals, original-rate linkage and loss-carry alternatives lack accepted canonical witnesses.
limitations: Exact signed arithmetic and correction deltas do not complete signed-return accounting policies.

features.description: Authorized source-to-target entitlement movement with conserved transaction identity is not integrated.
limitations: Within-pool recovery and ordinary allocations do not establish cross-contract transfer authority.

features.description: Native USD/EUR typed quote orientation and complete canonical conversion witness remain absent.
limitations: Existing record-backed FX arithmetic is a legitimate method fit. The required-extension selection gate remains active and no missing core capability has been reserved.

features.description: Supplied withholding plus minimum-payout/unpaid balance method has no canonical witness.
limitations: Fees, advances and LG holdback have different semantics and do not close this requirement.

features.description: Direct emitted-Lean decision instrumentation or validated target-coverage mechanism is absent.
limitations: Interpreter branch observations cannot be relabeled emitted target branch coverage, compiler line coverage or total possible-program coverage.

features.description: Full frontend, collection, emitter, codec and trace correctness proofs remain deferred.
limitations: Toy infrastructure and scoped scalar theorems do not prove the SPL compiler or its financial interpretations.
